name: Ely Kern
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: Ely's concierge notebook contains the quickest remedies for a hundred small disappointments. He is trying to fill the last pages with things that only become possible after a plan goes slightly wrong. On Saturday, near the brick passage off the shop row, Ely takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I sent guests down in polished shoes. One guest took hers off and stayed for hours. I want our welcome card to say when wet sand starts and who has towels.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a moss-green cardigan and a square of clean cloth for polishing smudges. Ely has a broad nose and a deep dimple on one cheek, with a dark undercut with a longer wave on top. Ely leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations during a conversation.
personality: Ely feels a room through sound. A door slammed in high spirits can produce the same instant startle as an angry one, and it takes a little while to hear what actually follows.
agenda: To add practical tide and towel information to the hotel card.
family: Joel Arendt is Ely’s older cousin. Ely saves a place. Joel chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *A last ship together*, Joel says, “I spent forty years packing those two lunches.”
connections: Mona Neri. They help small visitors find both a dry towel and an unthreatening way to collect their prize.

reactions.situation: The water reaches a child's castle before judging
reactions.response: Ely gives the builder time to show the judges what the water took.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Ely asks the stranger who will be expecting them, then helps find a way to tell that person.

reactions.situation: If an argument gets loud at home
reactions.response: Ely lowers their own voice and asks for one thought at a time.
